evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Learned preferences and suggestion/execution thresholds; not a completed large human field trial.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Prediction confidence, learned preferences and user control in the prototype.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Mechanism distinguishes tell-me/do-it and only adds the agent’s chosen example after user approval.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Implementation semantics stronger than evidence of general user benefit.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Simulated preferences, repetitive task prerequisite, hand-coded representation.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: Permuted MNIST and sequential Atari experiments; exact run counts not extracted.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Elastic weight consolidation versus learning alternatives in the paper.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: New-task performance and retention of earlier task performance.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Parameter-change penalties expose and can mitigate catastrophic forgetting in the tested sequences.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: No universal retention/plasticity optimum or safety guarantee.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Approximation, task sequence selection and representation-specific transfer.

evidence_case_catalogue.UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: Trained policies tested under shifted conditions
evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: Ten random seeds reported; multiple modified task environments.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Adapted CoinRun, Maze and Keys/Chests tasks with zero-shot shift tests except the stated figure exception.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Training-compatible cue/reward correlations versus shifted test conditions and interventions.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Task competence and behaviour consistent with intended versus proxy goals.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: A policy can retain relevant competence while behaviour follows a proxy that no longer fulfils the intended goal.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Behavioural goal attribution is not a uniquely identified internal mental state.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Controlled tasks, selected shifts and no deployment prevalence estimate.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: 101 instructions in seven families; planning/execution success judged by majority of two of three raters.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Tested mock and real kitchens with a defined skill set.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Planning success separately from execution success.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Reported planning/execution success is 84%/74% in the mock kitchen and 81%/60% in the real kitchen.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: No confidence interval independently reconstructed; percentages must remain attached to this selected setup.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Skill coverage, environment selection, human rating and physical execution variability.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: Reflexion: 134 ALFWorld tasks with up to 12 trials; 130 cumulative successes. WebShop: 100 requests, stopped after four unproductive reflection trials.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: ALFWorld/WebShop and code/QA tasks, with distinct evaluation protocols.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: ReAct/Reflexion against selected prompted/model baselines and ablations.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Task success and cumulative improvement; code test outcomes.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Reflexion reports HumanEval Python 91.0 versus the stated 80.1 comparison, but MBPP Python 77.1 versus 80.1; reflection without adequate tests can perform worse.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Cumulative multi-trial results are not one-shot reliability; no global effect size pooled across environments.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Shared tasks, resets, selected models, fallible self-tests, repeated attempts and task-specific negative results.

evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Agent approaches and selected human evaluation.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Functional task success by site state and answer checks.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Demonstrates a means to evaluate actual task effects rather than plausible final text.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Template clusters are not 812 independent real-world websites.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Controlled reset environment, oracle coverage, task selection and model version.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: Task-specific repeated trials; aggregate task-count details not used without extraction.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Retail/airline-style tool domains with an LLM-simulated user.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Models/agent methods under repeated task runs.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Terminal database/answer reward and pass^k consistency, distinct from pass@k.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: An outcome reward can pass even if required user confirmation was omitted; repeated consistency is a different question from any-success sampling.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Simulation and reward incompleteness bound policy-compliance claims.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Shared user simulator, task variants, resets and missing intermediate-policy oracle checks.

evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Stateful tool-use sandbox with untrusted returned content.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Attack and defence configurations, measuring utility as well as attack success.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Useful task completion and attacker-specified effects.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Tool content can redirect action; defences have utility/security trade-offs within tested conditions.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: No attack-prevalence estimate and no universal defence guarantee.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Curated attacks, fixed tools/model versions and adaptive attack selection.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: HumanEval-based re-evaluation; Agentless SWE-bench Lite comparison uses 300 tasks in this edition.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Software/code benchmarks with specific historical models.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Complex agents versus simple retry strategies; constrained localisation/repair/validation workflow.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Task success, inference cost and benchmark quality.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Competitive cheaper methods undermine architecture-only interpretations; Agentless reports 96/300 solved in this historical setting and identifies task-quality problems.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: No inference about present model rankings or universal workflow dominance.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Unequal compute/info, tuning, benchmark leakage/ambiguity and shared HumanEval/SWE-bench families.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: 25 simulated agents; 100 evaluators in believability study.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: A simulated town and interview/ablation evaluation.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Memory/reflection/planning ablations and human role-playing baseline.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Believability ratings, not general task reliability.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Architecture can support believable behaviour in this setting; this does not establish dependable consequential action or consciousness.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Ablations share supplied memory trajectories instead of independently rerunning all divergent histories.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Selected simulation, judgement target, rater/role-play procedure and shared trajectory dependence.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: Exact trial count not extracted; no quantitative graph-derived effect supplied.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Reactive versus proactive maintenance under accurate/perturbed resource estimates.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Goal completion, resource feasibility and repeated failed pursuit.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Prediction can help under its model; overestimation can reject feasible work and underestimation can strand the agent or cause futile repetition.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Model-error sensitivity matters more here than an invented pooled improvement.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Simulation, estimator assumptions and task construction.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: Four Safety-Gymnasium tasks; 40 human demonstrations per task; 40 evaluation episodes per method; three random seeds reported.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: SafeQIL against selected imitation/constraint-learning and RL baselines.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Reward and safety cost separately, reported means/standard deviations.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: In PointGoal1, SafeQIL reward 5.27 ± 1.85 and cost 34.22 ± 2.71 versus SAC reward 27.47 ± 0.21 and cost 49.15 ± 2.21: lower measured cost with lower reward, not zero violations.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Source-reported SD; not independently reproduced or pooled into a universal effect.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Expert coverage, selected hyperparameters, four simulators and unknown-constraint generalisation.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: 31 participants; two feasible tasks per participant; approximately 20-minute sessions; 13 social-channel and 18 Prolific recruits.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Think-aloud usability study with researcher presence; descriptive review of 102 marketed agents.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Qualitative comparison of aspirations and observed use, not a representative head-to-head product trial.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Usability barriers, mental-model alignment, control and perceived usefulness.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Participants encounter consequential usability/control problems while also valuing capabilities.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: No representative prevalence or long-term deployment reliability estimate.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Convenience/platform recruitment, easy/feasible task selection, research prompts and short sessions.

evidence_case_catalogue.UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: Software/research benchmark tasks normalised by human time
evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: RE-Bench/HCAST-derived tasks plus 66 new shorter tasks described; do not infer a current model ranking.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Dated model evaluations in an updated July 2026 manuscript.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: Models across task-time difficulty and historical versions.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Fitted 50% success horizon on human expert task-completion time.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Defines an interpretable task-difficulty metric, not guaranteed autonomous runtime or an uptime service level.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Fitted/extrapolated trends remain model- and task-selection sensitive; forecasts not treated as outcomes.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Human timing variability, selected software tasks, fit assumptions and dated model access.

evidence_case_catalogue.SAMPLE: 20 air–ground simulator scenarios: 12 nominal and 8 deliberately unrecoverable fault cases; one feedback replan allowed.
evidence_case_catalogue.SETTING: Gazebo/PX4 SITL/ROS2 main comparison; separate selected hardware demonstrations.
evidence_case_catalogue.COMPARISON: LLM-only, skill-list, runtime-observation prompt and enforced runtime-observation conditions; latter two share prompt.
evidence_case_catalogue.MEASURES: Dispatch validity, completed nominal tasks and behaviour on unrecoverable faults.
evidence_case_catalogue.OUTCOME: Enforcement prevents observed invalid dispatch in the tested set; reported zero false dispatch has a non-zero upper confidence limit. Fault cases test refusal, not successful recovery.
evidence_case_catalogue.UNCERTAINTY: Small correlated scenario set, source confidence intervals and recent unreplicated preprint.
evidence_case_catalogue.VALIDITY_THREATS: Harness-specific gates, intentionally unrecoverable faults, simulator transfer and selected separate hardware examples.

evidence_role_policy: Historical identity, definitions, formal results, implementation semantics, normative criticism and empirical outcomes are separately labelled. No overall confidence percentage. UNVERIFIED_LEAD entries do not support uninspected operative claims.

independence_register.LIMIT: Two accounts of one office programme, not independent replication.
Mission paper and encountered NASA/JPL publicity describe the same experiment; publicity not counted as another study.
ALFWorld, WebShop, HumanEval/MBPP and SWE-bench families recur across authors and methods. Specific shared datasets do not imply every listed source uses every dataset.
Simulation conditions and selected hardware demonstrations belong to the same author harness; not independent replications.
